::: {.headline}
Welcome to the [slide decks]{.teal}
:::

::: {.subhead}
A short guide to driving a deck
:::

::: {.note}
Press <kbd>→</kbd> or <kbd>Space</kbd> to begin.
:::

## Moving around

::: {.subhead}
Forward, back, and the bird's-eye view.
:::

## Forward and back

::: {.lead}
Press <kbd>Space</kbd> to go through the whole deck in order. Or use <kbd>→</kbd> and <kbd>←</kbd> to step forward and back.
:::

The arrows all move one slide at a time, so <kbd>→</kbd> and <kbd>↓</kbd> do the same thing. The bar along the bottom shows how far through you are.

## Sections

A deck is grouped into sections. This slide is in the "Moving around" section.

::: {.lead}
The faint label in the bottom-right names the section you are in, so you keep your place in a long deck.
:::

::: {.fragment .panel .teal}
To jump straight to another section, use the overview on the next slide.
:::

## See every slide at once

Press <kbd>Esc</kbd> or <kbd>O</kbd> for the overview grid. Every slide shrinks to a thumbnail, with each section in its own column: sections across, slides down.

Click any thumbnail to jump straight there. This is the quick way to move between sections.

::: {.note}
The menu button in the bottom-left corner opens the same slides as a list.
:::

# Building slides {.center}

::: {.subhead}
A couple of things slides can do.
:::

## Reveal one point at a time

Some slides build up step by step. Each press of <kbd>→</kbd> brings in the next piece rather than moving on.

::: {.fragment}
First this point appears,
:::

::: {.fragment}
then this one,
:::

::: {.fragment .accent}
then the last one, before the next slide.
:::

## Speaker notes

Press <kbd>S</kbd> to open the speaker view: the current slide, the next one, your notes, and a timer, in a separate window. The audience never sees it.

This slide has a note. Press <kbd>S</kbd> now to read it.

::: {.notes}
This is a speaker note. Only you see it in the speaker view. Write reminders, figures, or the point you must not forget here.
:::

# Presenting {.center}

::: {.subhead}
For when you are in front of an audience.
:::

## Full screen, and a pause

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
**Full screen**

Press <kbd>F</kbd> to fill the screen, and <kbd>Esc</kbd> to leave it.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
**Blank the screen**

Press <kbd>B</kbd> or <kbd>.</kbd> to black out the screen when you want all eyes on you, and again to bring it back.
:::
:::

## Every shortcut

Press <kbd>?</kbd> at any time for the full list of keyboard shortcuts.

::: {.lead}
The ones worth knowing: <kbd>→</kbd> <kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>↓</kbd> <kbd>↑</kbd> move, <kbd>Esc</kbd> overview, <kbd>S</kbd> notes, <kbd>F</kbd> full screen, <kbd>B</kbd> blank, <kbd>?</kbd> help.
:::

# Find your way home {.center}

::: {.lead}
On the public site at [slides.causalmap.app](https://slides.causalmap.app), click [Home]{.teal} in the top-right corner to return to the list of all decks.
:::

::: {.fragment .panel .teal}
That is everything. Pick a deck from the home page and press <kbd>→</kbd>.
:::
